description: JG v2.0 revision (ZQH comment 1.1): break the ground-truth circularity. The injected truth leaves the constant-harmonic trajectory basis (multi-year seasonal amplitude modulation, long-lived transients, logarithmic relaxation). Each regime is scored with the 10 learned seeds trained on its own truth family (in-family nets on in-family truth, out-of-family nets on out-of-family truth) and 5 independent noise realisations per station/component, hybrid and fully synthetic. Denoising is scored under both normalisation arms; the per-window arm is the protocol-matched primary result.
